name: mcp-opnsense
description: Slim OPNsense MCP Server — 62 tools for managing firewall infrastructure via the OPNsense REST API. Covers DNS/Unbound, Firewall rules, Diagnostics, Interfaces, DHCP (ISC + Kea), System/Backups, ACME/Let's Encrypt, and Firmware. No SSH, no shell, API-only with 3 runtime dependencies. AGPL-3.0 + Commercial dual-licensed.
